title: Static Wide-Cephalofoil Hammerhead Shark
description: One newly authored whole stylised hammerhead-shark-like exterior. A genuinely transverse broad flattened cephalofoil joins continuously through a narrowed neck to an elongated tapered trunk and narrow tail peduncle. Widely separated lateral eyes sit at the head wings. Two large swept pectoral fins, two small pelvic fins, a tall swept first dorsal and low secondary dorsal, and a clearly unequal upper/lower caudal silhouette form one static animal. Every body/head station and complete fin outline is new, not an old fork-tail fish with a head accessory or widened ray disc. One model, zero scenes. Fixed resting game-art datum only, not natural standing support, exact species/anatomy, gills/mouth internals, teeth, swimming, predation, rig, animation or interaction.
